q.title: Measured quality
q.lede: Every number on this page is recomputed by CI on each deploy. If search quality drops below its thresholds or a lesson claim stops matching its exercise, the site does not ship.
q.search.body: A labeled set of real questions, each mapped to the section that answers it. Retrieval is scored at section level: hit@1 is the share of questions whose answer is ranked first, hit@3 within the top three, MRR the mean of 1/rank (0 below rank 10). Spanish uses the same questions translated, against the Spanish lessons. Two embedding models are measured: all-MiniLM-L6-v2, trained on English, and multilingual-e5-small.
q.search.noSemantic: Meaning and hybrid modes were not measured in this build (no embeddings).
q.rankHint: Rank of the first expected section; — means not in the top 10.
q.search.gate: CI fails the deploy if any measured mode drops below the thresholds stored in tests/search-eval.json.
q.claims.body: Lessons do not contain hand-typed results. {n} numbers and tables across {lessons} lessons are placeholders filled from the output CI records by running each exercise with real Python. The build fails if any of them stops matching.
q.parity.body: Each exercise runs in the browser on Pyodide. CI records the real output with Python {python} on {date} and runs every exercise again in headless Chromium.
q.parity.real: Output identical to real Python (real NumPy, no substitutes)
q.parity.within: Every number within {d} of real Python
q.minilm.body: The browser runs a NumPy implementation of all-MiniLM-L6-v2 ({w} weights). Its largest cosine-similarity difference from PyTorch on the check sentences is {d}; CI fails above 0.005.
q.noRuntime: This build has no Python runtime, so parity was not measured.

home.map: Every section of the course. Lines join a lesson's sections in reading order; faint lines link the most related sections across lessons. Bigger dots are sections many others relate to, numbers mark where each lesson starts. Drag to turn, pinch or use + and − to zoom, and select a dot to open it.
q.search.shipped: The site ships {mode}, the best hybrid MRR whose model runs in the browser.
q.e5.body: For meaning search the browser can also run a NumPy implementation of multilingual-e5-small ({w} weights, vocabulary trimmed to {v} Latin-script pieces). Its SentencePiece tokenizer matched Hugging Face exactly on {exact} of {n} check sentences, and its largest cosine-similarity difference from PyTorch on Latin-script text is {d}; CI fails above 0.01. Text in other scripts falls back to unknown pieces.
